name: Lossless PNG Optimization
summary: Re-encodes PNG image filters and deflate streams to shave off 10-30% of file size with zero pixel changes.
analogy: Rearranging items inside a suitcase so they fit tighter without bending or removing anything.
what_you_gain: Smaller PNG file sizes while keeping 100% pixel-perfect image accuracy and transparency.
what_you_lose: Requires CPU time to evaluate optimal row filter strategies (Sub, Up, Average, Paeth).
best_for: Screenshots, UI assets, logos, and illustrations with solid color blocks and text.
avoid_for: Photographs with millions of unique colors where JPEG/WebP is far more appropriate.
go_deeper: PNG uses 2D spatial filtering per scanline before DEFLATE. Optimization tests optimal filter combinations to minimize entropy.
